name: Steal My Heart
source:
You are a young woman who works at a museum, and the daughter of a philanthropic archaeologist who went missing several years ago on an expedition to find some legendary magic jewels. These jewels were said to contain a mysterious power that could grant the person who finds them any wish, and your father was dedicated to find the truth. 

One night while closing up the museum, a strange guest enters and mentions your father. But you soon feel threatened by this intriguing yet terrifying stranger, and in the nick of time, a mysterious, handsome young man appears and whisks you away "to safety..." Later, you find yourself in a secret hideout surrounded by three attractive men, including your rescuer, who are determined to protect you, and find the same jewels your father was looking for! 

Could they hold the key to the whereabouts of your father, and the secrets of his research? How do they know him, and what do they know about the jewels? Also, who is the strange figure who broke into the museum? What secrets do these people know? And why do they all want YOU? 

In one single, eventful day, you soon find yourself thrust into a brand new world of secrets, magic, mystery, and the hidden world of the legendary Phantom Thieves. These thieves have long been known to steal various artifacts... but which one will be able to steal your heart?
translation:
你是一位在博物馆工作的年轻女性，也是一位慈善考古学家的女儿，几年前，她在一次寻找传奇魔法珠宝的探险中失踪。据说这些珠宝含有一种神秘的力量，可以实现找到它们的人的任何愿望，而你的父亲致力于寻找真相。

一天晚上，博物馆关闭时，一位陌生的客人进来并提到了你的父亲。但你很快就感受到了这个有趣而又可怕的陌生人的威胁，就在千钧一发之际，一个神秘英俊的年轻人出现了，他把你带到了“安全的地方”……后来，你发现自己身处一个秘密藏身处，周围环绕着三个迷人的男人，其中包括你的救援者，他们决心保护你，并找到你父亲一直在寻找的同样的珠宝！

他们能否掌握你父亲下落以及他研究秘密的钥匙？他们如何认识他？他们对珠宝了解多少？还有，闯入博物馆的奇怪人物是谁？这些人到底知道什么秘密？为什么他们都想要你？

在一个多事的一天里，你很快就会发现自己被带入了一个全新的世界，充满了秘密、魔法、神秘，以及传说中的怪盗团的隐藏世界。这些小偷长期以来以偷窃各种文物而闻名……但哪一个能够偷走你的心呢？
